scope: Pure JS prototype; synthetic samples, not Unity or headset verification

checks.name: positive X drags negative X
negative X drags positive X
positive Y drags negative Y
negative Y drags positive Y
stopped returns by the configured exponential
lifted returns by the configured exponential
tracking_lost returns by the configured exponential
first sample has no velocity spike at an arbitrary position
recontact and recovery do not differentiate across missing samples
switching board clears bend and establishes a new local baseline
pure board-normal motion never bends
duplicate timestamps neither integrate nor poison the prior point
backwards time, long gap, and invalid time reset safely
invalid point decays and requires a new baseline
sub-deadzone motion does not accumulate drift
large and changing velocities remain bounded
reversal converges to the new opposite direction
shaft, ferrule, root and visible contact tip are unchanged
only bristle belly bows, including transformed pen-local Z
30/60/90/120 Hz produce the same constant-speed response and return
invalid configuration and deformation arguments are rejected
